Sparkbeam Scroll.description: A tiny crackling bolt of harmless lightning. Good for lighting candles or scaring raccoons.

Featherfall Rune.description: Invoke to drift safely downward. Very soothing, very floaty.

Mirror Image Charm.description: Creates two illusory copies of yourself that mimic your moves.

Potion of Minor Healing.description: A soft rosy glow and a warm taste of cinnamon.

Elixir of Focus.description: Clears the mind and sharpens thought. Elowen brews it but rarely drinks it herself.

Potion of Invisibility (Short).description: Grants about 30 seconds of invisibility. Enough to sneak by a bored guard.

Aether Moth Wings.description: Delicate, shimmering wings still humming with energy.

Crystallized Moondew.description: A rare ingredient formed only on midnight leaves under a full moon.

Golden Thread.description: Spun from enchanted gold fibers. Essential for master-level crafting.

Enchanted Gemstone.description: A gemstone imbued with arcane energy. Pulses with inner light.

Muttering Skull.description: It mumbles random trivia. Sometimes helpful. Sometimes insulting.

Pocket Portal Pebble.description: Throw it to create a temporary doorway two feet to the left.

Spellbook Pages (Blank).description: High-quality parchment ready for new spells.

Enchanted Ink Vials.description: Ink that glows faintly and never blots.

restock_schedule.spells: Restocks weekly when Elowen finishes her scribing.
restock_schedule.ingredients: Collected or bartered on Elowen’s wandering days.
